description: Aéroport du Maroc is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Geomatic (the credit shown on the ArcGIS item). Le Maroc dispose d’un patrimoine aéroportuaire composé de 26 aéroports implantés dans les principales villes du Royaume répartis comme suit: 18 aéroports internationaux: Aéroport HUB CASA MOHAMMED V Aéroports consolidés 300 000 PAX: MARRAKECH MENARA, TANGER IBN BATTOUTA, AGADIR AL MASSIRA, FES SAISS, OUJDA ANGADS, NADOR EL AROUI, RABAT SALE Aéroports consolidés LAAYOUNE HASSAN 1 ... Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Geomatic (the credit shown on the ArcGIS item). Its tags are Aéroport, Maroc, Morocco. The portal shows 2018-05-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
